# Project Guidelines

## Code Style
- Use HTML5 with embedded CSS in `<head>` for simplicity.
- Prefer ID-based selectors for unique elements.
- Use absolute positioning and transforms for layout and animations.
- Ensure CSS syntax is correct (e.g., semicolons after properties).

## Architecture
- Single static HTML page with visual simulation of the Trolley Problem.
- Components: main container, trolley div with rails, tracks, and train elements.
- Assets: PNG images for background, tracks, train, and characters.

## Build and Test
- No build required; open `trolleyproblem.html` in a browser to view.
- Test by checking visual layout and ensuring all images load.

## Conventions
- Embed CSS in HTML head for self-contained files.
- Use background-image properties for visual elements.
- Include ethical dilemmas in `EthicalDilemas.txt` for reference.
